name: document_level_benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate document-level understanding and question answering across longer texts; it focuses on models' ability to reason over and extract answers from whole documents rather than single sentences. It contains document-context QA instances requiring multi-sentence and cross-paragraph reasoning.
evaluation_method: F1 and exact_match (standard QA metrics) where applicable
reputation: Small/niche dataset on Hugging Face used for document-level QA experiments but not broadly adopted as a standard benchmark.
